items.meaning: DHCP provides a superset of the functions provided by BOOTP.
DHCP provides a mechanism for transmitting configuration parameters to hosts using TCP/IP.
The format of DHCP messages is based on the format of BOOTP messages.
The BOOTP vendor extensions field was renamed the options field in DHCP.
DHCP messages that include a DHCP message type option are referred to by the type of the message.
A DHCP message with DHCP message type option type 1 is referred to as a DHCPDISCOVER message.
Some aspects of the BOOTP protocol were rather loosely defined in its original specification.
The behavior of BOOTP relay agents was originally described only generally.
DHCP servers are able to tell clients that they do not have an IP address to offer.
The DHCP client should not generate an IP address of its own when no address is offered.
items.constraint: should not generate an IP address it's own

items.meaning: This document defines a new DHCP option passed from the DHCP Server to the DHCP Client.
RFC 2132 allows DHCP servers to specify configuration information for name services to be passed to DHCP clients.
A DHCP server returns name service option codes in its preferred order.
items.constraint: SHOULD return the 16-bit network byte order integer option code for the name services in preferred order
items.object: the 16-bit network byte order integer option code for the name services

items.meaning: DHCP provides a framework for passing configuration information to hosts on a TCP/IP network.
DHCP protocol messages are identified by the DHCP Message Type option, option code 51.
该 DHCP 选项由 DHCP 客户端用来可选地标识其所代表的用户或应用的种类或类别，选项内容为表示客户端所属 user class 的不透明字段。
该选项应当可由用户配置。
items.constraint: should be configurable by a user

items.meaning: 使用 DHCP 获取网络地址等配置参数的 Internet 主机；User Class 选项由它用来标识其代表的用户或应用类别。
向 DHCP 客户端返回配置参数的 Internet 主机；它依据客户端所属的 user class 选择地址池与配置参数。
包含至少一个 IP 地址、与某 DHCP 客户端相关联（绑定）的配置参数集合，由 DHCP 服务器管理。
新定义的 DHCP 选项，允许 DHCP 客户端指定在其上分配地址的子网，并优先于 DHCP 服务器自行确定子网的方法。
items.constraint: takes precedence over the methods that the DHCP server uses to determine the subnet on which to select an address

items.meaning: 为分配地址而确定请求来源子网，并在来源子网上或与来源子网同网段的子网上选择地址的服务器。
DHCP 包头部字段，其子网地址可用于确定请求来源子网（当该字段非零时）。
由 DHCP 中继代理在向 DHCP 服务器转发源自客户端的 DHCP 包时插入的新 DHCP 选项，由一个或多个子选项组成。
items.constraint: inserted by the DHCP relay agent when forwarding client-originated DHCP packets to a DHCP server; the DHCP Server echoes the option back verbatim to the relay agent in server-to-client replies, and the relay agent strips the option before forwarding the reply to the client

items.meaning: 识别 Relay Agent Information 选项的服务器可在服务器到客户端应答中把该选项原样回送给中继代理。
items.constraint: echoes the option back verbatim to the relay agent in server-to-client replies

items.meaning: 初始子选项之一，用于标识来话电路。
初始子选项之一，为远端高速调制解调器提供可信标识符。
一种负载均衡参数，允许参与负载均衡方案的服务器延迟服务某客户端，而不是忽略该客户端。
一种配置指令，用于分配一组散列桶值。
本文档定义的新 DHCP 选项，通过它可生成授权票据，并可从经过认证的 DHCP 服务器自动配置获得适当授权的新接入主机。
针对 DHCP 客户端的攻击是可能出现一台“rogue”服务器，其意图是向该客户端提供错误的配置信息。
DHCP 服务器向客户端发送单播 FORCERENEW 消息。
如果 FORCERENEW 消息丢失，DHCP 服务器应使用指数退避算法重传该 FORCERENEW 消息。
items.constraint: 应使用指数退避算法重传 FORCERENEW
items.object: 使用指数退避算法重传该 FORCERENEW 消息
items.condition: 如果 FORCERENEW 消息丢失

items.object: 收到多播 FORCERENEW 消息
items.condition: 客户端收到多播 FORCERENEW 消息时

items.meaning: 中继代理必须将 Device Class 值原样传递给 DHCP 服务器。
items.constraint: 必须将 Device Class 值原样传递
items.object: 原样传递给 DHCP 服务器的 Device Class 值

items.meaning: SIP 服务器必须是出站代理服务器。
items.constraint: 必须是出站代理服务器

items.meaning: DHCP 选项从 DHCP 服务器传递给 DHCP 客户端。
此选项废弃静态路由选项（选项 33）。
本文档定义了一个 DHCP 选项。
IANA will make unused DHCP option codes available for assignment to other DHCP options in the future.
Option codes not currently documented in an RFC should not be made available for reassignment to future DHCP options.
items.constraint: should not be made available for reassignment to future DHCP options
items.object: for reassignment to future DHCP options
items.condition: not currently documented in an RFC

items.meaning: The option codes listed in Section 2 are to be returned to IANA for reassignment to new options.
items.constraint: are to be returned to IANA for reassignment to new options

items.meaning: A DHCP client can represent multiple vendors, which can make DHCP vendor class and vendor-specific options limiting or ambiguous.
The document defines two new options that contain Enterprise Numbers to remove ambiguity.
The vendor identified by option 60 defines the interpretation of option 43.
The document specifies the format for encoding DHCPv4 client identifiers so they are interchangeable with DHCPv6 identifiers.
This document specifies the way DHCPv4 clients should identify themselves.
Conforming DHCPv4 client implementations use a DHCP Unique Identifier (DUID) as specified in DHCPv6.
items.constraint: use a DUID as specified in DHCPv6

items.meaning: A DHCPv4 option can be used to exchange information about a DHCPv4 client's FQDN and about responsibility for updating the DNS RR related to the client's address assignment.
The option conveys a DHCPv4 client's fully qualified domain name.
The option conveys responsibility for updating the DNS RR related to the client's address assignment.
RFC 4776 corrects the numeric value assignment of the DHCPv6 option-code in RFC 4676 Section 3.2.
The DHCP option contains the civic location of the client or the DHCP server.
The Location Configuration Information includes country, administrative units, street addresses, postal community names, and building information.
The option allows multiple renditions of the same address in different scripts and languages.
POSIX 1003.1 时区字符串是传递时区信息的常见方式之一。
时区数据库名称是传递时区信息的另一种常见方式。
该备忘录为每种时区信息传递方法指定 DHCP 选项。
DHCPv4 时间偏移选项已被弃用。
该备忘录定义了 DHCP 中继代理信息选项的一个新子选项。
定义了一个标志，用于指示 DHCP 中继收到转发的数据包是单播还是广播。
标志指示 DHCP 中继收到该数据包时使用的是单播还是广播。
DHCP 服务器可以使用该信息，根据客户端请求最初是广播还是单播来更好地服务客户端。
该备忘录定义了 DHCPv4 虚拟子网选择（VSS）选项。
该备忘录定义了 DHCPv6 VSS 选项。
VSS-Control 是 DHCPv4 中承载在 Relay Agent Information 选项内的子选项。
DHCPv4 中继代理信息选项承载 VSS 和 VSS-Control 子选项。
VSS 信息预期供 DHCP 客户端、中继代理和代理客户端使用。
该备忘录更新 RFC 3046，涉及与子选项复制有关的细节。
DHCP FORCERENEW 允许通过由 DHCP 服务器触发、迫使 DHCP 客户端进入 Renew 状态来重配置单个主机。
FORCERENEW 迫使 DHCP 客户端进入 Renew 状态。
FORCERENEW 的触发来自 DHCP 服务器。
在 Forcerenew Nonce Authentication 协议中，服务器向客户端发送 nonce。
nonce 包含在初始 DHCP ACK 中，用于后续验证 FORCERENEW 消息。
该文档更新 RFC 3203。
该文档更新 RFC 2131。
client identifier 选项是服务器不得返回给客户端的选项。
items.constraint: 服务器不得向客户端返回 'client identifier' 选项。
items.object: the 'client identifier' option to the client

items.meaning: A relay agent may use any available source port for upstream communications.
A DHCP option can be included to statelessly route responses back to the appropriate source port on downstream communications.
A DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 option is described to inform clients that they are behind a captive portal enforcement device.
Clients are informed that they are behind some sort of captive portal enforcement device and need to satisfy Captive Portal conditions to get Internet access.
The network operator may convey the captive portal API endpoint to hosts.
A DHCPv4 option indicates that a host supports an IPv6-only mode and is willing to forgo obtaining an IPv4 address if the network provides IPv6 connectivity.
DHCPv4 server behavior is specified for when the server receives a DHCPDISCOVER not containing the Auto-Configure option but containing the new option.
A DHCPDISCOVER not containing the Auto-Configure option but containing the new option is part of the server behavior condition.
New DHCP and IPv6 Router Advertisement options are used to discover encrypted DNS resolvers.
A host can learn an Authentication Domain Name together with a list of IP addresses and a set of service parameters to reach encrypted DNS resolvers.
The Authentication Domain Name is learned together with a list of IP addresses and service parameters to reach encrypted DNS resolvers.
BOOTP is an IP/UDP bootstrap protocol that allows a diskless client machine to discover its own IP address, the address of a server host, and the name of a file to be loaded into memory and executed.
The client broadcasts a bootrequest packet.
The server answers with a bootreply packet.
The bootrequest contains the client's hardware address and its IP address, if known.
When the server sends the bootreply, it replaces the generic filename field with the fully qualified path name of the appropriate boot file.
The server may consult its own database correlating the client's address and filename request with a particular boot file.
A mechanism should be provided for the user to manually supply the necessary address and filename information to bypass the BOOTP protocol and enter the file transfer phase directly.
items.constraint: A mechanism should be provided for the user to manually supply the necessary address and filename information to bypass the BOOTP protocol and enter the file transfer phase directly.

items.meaning: If the cached information fails, the bootstrap should fall back to phase 1 and use BOOTP.
items.constraint: If the cached information fails, the bootstrap should fall back to phase 1 and use BOOTP.
items.action: fall back to phase 1 and use BOOTP
